fila1.descripcion: Graduates will be able to analyze, design, develop, and implement software and hardware systems; manage IT projects; apply engineering methodologies and standards; and communicate results orally and in writing in professional and academic settings.
fila1.textoExtra: Computer engineers can work in public and private sector organizations in software development, databases, networks, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, teaching and research, as well as in technology entrepreneurship.

fila2.descripcion: Applicants are encouraged to have a solid foundation in mathematics (algebra, geometry, precalculus), logical and abstract reasoning skills, as well as an interest in technology and solving problems using computers.
fila2.textoExtra: It is desirable to have analytical skills, teamwork ability, discipline for self-directed study, scientific curiosity, and a willingness to continuously update one's knowledge in a constantly evolving field.

mision.descripcion: To educate computer engineering professionals with a strong scientific and humanistic foundation, capable of analyzing, designing, implementing, and managing technological solutions that contribute to societal development, in alignment with UNAM principles and values.

vision.descripcion: To be a leading academic program in computer engineering education, recognized for teaching quality, engagement with industry, and contributions to innovation, research, and the training of professionals committed to Mexico.

valores.descripcion: Honesty, responsibility, respect, equity, freedom of thought and critique, commitment to academic excellence, collaborative work, and service to the university community and society.
